studies.question: Does making equivalent outputs agree add value beyond teaching the same paired examples normally?
studies.method: Four inherited NEW/M32 parents (4101-4104), matched 512-update SUP/CONS branches; identical task/current-cue/paired-neutral supervision; CONS alone adds fixed 0.01 raw-output-logit consistency loss. Primary events 1-128 after a 32-event prefix; extension 129-512 (P22-P47, T4).
studies.outcome: Primary events 1-128: neutral U had 97,889/98,304 events, 756/768 paths, and 186 false-DONE; both SUP and CONS had 98,304/98,304 events and 768/768 paths, with zero false-DONE/noncompletion (T1,T5). Across 512 events, SUP was perfect; CONS had 393,145/393,216 events, 767/768 paths, and 71 late false-DONE (T6). Dynamic whole-history results, CONS vs SUP: 226/256 vs 234/256 primary and 151/256 vs 170/256 cumulative; cumulative wrong pending choices were 191 vs 87 (P74). Frozen qualification failed relative-benefit, 3-of-4 basic-quality, and every-parent no-harm. SUP's zero false-DONE made the benefit gate uninformative. No post-hoc SUP replacement; unchanged U4101 step-512 fallback.
studies.status: COMPLETE_BOUNDED_TRAINING_COMPARISON / NO_INCREMENTAL_CONSISTENCY_QUALIFICATION / SUPERVISED_NEUTRAL_GAIN_WITH_RETENTION_LIMITS / UNCHANGED_BASELINE_DEMO
limitations: Bounded to four inherited parents and an eight-item task; retention does not establish new associations.
Only one consistency loss was tested; this does not establish universal harm or external replication.
An audit-cost gap remains.
The report notes the original source-63 raw 4104 shard was missing; retain this as a report-scoped evidence limit.
The report says its own raw data is present, but local raw-data possession and integrity are not verified by this lane.
studies.evidence_tier: Accepted report result review with exact OOXML table/paragraph locators; no local raw-data possession or integrity verification.
